papers.abstract: Single-cell multi-omics data offer an opportunity to resolve how gene regulatory networks (GRNs) are rewired during cell-fate transitions, but most existing methods infer static snapshots, ignore temporal dependencies or assume linear regulation. Here we present DRAFT, a deep learning framework that combines graph attention with recurrent temporal memory to infer dynamic GRNs from time-resolved single-cell multi-omics data. On simulated data, DRAFT outperforms existing methods in accuracy and temporal smoothness. In mouse cellular reprogramming and Drosophila adult spermatogenesis, it recovers interactions supported by independent ChIP-seq, perturbation and Hi-C data, together with known stage-specific regulators. By inferring regulatory activity from dynamic network structure rather than expression alone, DRAFT identifies regulators whose activity precedes their transcriptional peak, including the candidate early germline regulator Mondo. Germline-specific Mondo knockdown alters germline stem cell number and expression of the predicted targets kuz and mamo. DRAFT also enables nonlinear alignment of co-developing lineages and reveals stage-specific cell-cell communication.

summary.takeaway: 提出DRAFT框架，结合图注意力与循环时序记忆，从时间分辨的单细胞多组学数据推断动态基因调控网络，并可从网络结构推断调控活性。
summary.methods: 深度学习框架融合图注意力与循环时序记忆；在模拟数据上评估精度和时序平滑性；应用于小鼠细胞重编程和果蝇成虫精子发生数据，并与ChIP-seq、扰动和Hi-C数据对照；对候选早期生殖系调控因子Mondo进行生殖系特异性敲低验证；还用于共发育谱系的非线性对齐和阶段特异性细胞通讯分析。
summary.relevance: 直接对应“GRN / Regulon”主题：该工作关注从单细胞多组学轨迹推断动态基因调控网络及调控因子活性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明所用时间分辨单细胞多组学数据的类型、规模及对时间点采样密度的敏感性；动态GRN推断的因果性仍依赖计算推断与有限扰动验证。

papers.title: LipidRT: leveraging retention time coherence for robust lipid annotation in reversed-phase LC-MS-based lipidomics
papers.abstract: MS/MS data alone is often insufficient for confident lipid identification, while existing retention time (RT)-based methods, despite their promise, have limited applicability. We present LipidRT, an R-based Shiny application that uses RT coherence to validate, refine and expand lipid annotations in untargeted RPLC-HRMS lipidomics in a dataset-specific, software-agnostic manner. By exploiting conserved chromatographic elution relationships as structural constraints and excluding RT-inconsistent annotations from model fitting, LipidRT improves annotation confidence, coverage and consistency while minimizing manual curation.

summary.takeaway: 提出LipidRT，一个R Shiny应用，利用反相液相色谱-高分辨质谱中保留时间的连贯性来验证、修正和扩展脂质注释。
summary.methods: 基于R的Shiny应用；利用保守的色谱洗脱关系作为结构约束，并将保留时间不一致的注释排除在模型拟合之外；以数据集特异、软件无关的方式处理非靶向RPLC-HRMS脂质组学数据。
summary.relevance: 被匹配到“检索增强与对齐”主题，但从摘要看其核心是脂质组学注释中的保留时间一致性约束，与检索增强或对齐方法的直接关联有限。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供与其他注释工具的定量比较、具体数据集规模和错误率；所述“提高注释置信度、覆盖度和一致性”缺乏数值证据。

papers.title: A Hierarchical KAN-Augmented Graph Convolutional Model for Inferring Cell-Type-Specific Gene Regulations in Single-Cell Omics.
papers.abstract: Accurate inference of gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from single-cell RNA-seq data remains challenging due to the complexity of transcription factor (TF)-target interactions and the difficulty in capturing both local and global regulatory dependencies. Here, we present GeneKAN, a novel deep learning framework that integrates multiscale graph convolution with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for robust GRN inference. GeneKAN employs a kernel-based graph convolution module to hierarchically encode gene representations, while KANs model high-order, interpretable TF-target relationships through learnable spline activations. Benchmarking against eleven existing models, and seven scRNA-seq datasets from BEELINE, including diverse cell types, species, and ground-truth networks (ChIP-seq, STRING, LOF/GOF), demonstrates that our proposed GeneKAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in both AUROC and AUPRC. Ablation studies of the proposed model confirm the necessity of each component. Biological validation on human hepatocyte and lung cancer datasets reveals that GeneKAN not only recovers known regulatory interactions with high precision but also identifies functionally relevant hub genes and oncogenic pathways. GeneKAN thus offers a powerful, interpretable, and scalable solution for GRN reconstruction under real-world conditions of data sparsity and noise, with significant potential for advancing systems biology and precision medicine.

summary.takeaway: 提出GeneKAN，将多尺度图卷积与Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks结合，用于从单细胞RNA测序数据推断基因调控网络。
summary.methods: 使用基于核的图卷积模块分层编码基因表示，并用KAN的可学习样条激活建模高阶、可解释的转录因子-靶标关系；在BEELINE的七个scRNA-seq数据集上与十一个现有模型比较，使用AUROC和AUPRC评估；进行消融实验；在人类肝细胞和肺癌数据上做生物学验证。
summary.relevance: 直接对应“GRN / Regulon”主题：该工作聚焦单细胞组学中的基因调控网络推断与调控关系建模。
summary.caveat: 摘要中的性能优势主要基于BEELINE基准和所选评价指标；真实数据验证为回顾性恢复已知调控和通路，未说明在不同数据稀疏度与噪声条件下的系统鲁棒性。

papers.title: Unveiling value functions in social cognition with multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning
papers.abstract: Social behavior requires individuals to consider not only their own goals but also those of others. Latent reward functions that encode such goals can be recovered from behavior using inverse reinforcement learning in single-agent settings. However, extending this to multi-agent interactions is challenging, as joint reward functions are defined over joint state spaces that grow exponentially with the number of agents. Existing approaches address this complexity by imposing restrictive assumptions on social interactions, limiting generality and interpretability. Here we show that joint reward functions governing social interactions can be efficiently represented through decomposition into individual reward maps for each agent and low-dimensional interaction terms. Building on this formulation, we introduce a general multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning framework (MAIRL) that enables scalable and interpretable inference of latent reward representations directly from behavior. In simulated social tasks with known ground-truth rewards, MAIRL recovered the rewarded states and imitated expert behavior as accurately as or better than existing multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning methods. Applying MAIRL to mouse and primate social tasks, we recover structured reward maps that reflect distinct social roles and interaction strategies during group behavior. These results establish MAIRL as a general framework for identifying latent objectives underlying multi-agent behavior across species and paradigms.

summary.takeaway: 提出多智能体逆强化学习框架MAIRL，通过将联合奖励函数分解为个体奖励图与低维交互项，从行为中推断社会交互中的潜在奖励结构。
summary.methods: 将联合奖励函数表示为每个智能体的个体奖励图加低维交互项；在已知真实奖励的模拟社会任务中评估，并与现有多智能体逆强化学习方法比较；应用于小鼠和灵长类社会任务，恢复奖励图和交互策略。
summary.relevance: 对应“强化学习”主题：该工作属于逆强化学习在多智能体社会行为建模中的方法与应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明分解假设在何种交互复杂度下成立、模型对真实动物行为数据的拟合优度，以及从小鼠和灵长类数据推断出的奖励图的可验证性。

papers.title: Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features: A Reusable Basis for Continual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Continual reinforcement learning requires agents to adapt when the task changes while reusing what they know about the environment. Successor features separate dynamics from task-specific reward, but their effectiveness depends on the choice of base features. Taking the identification of entorhinal grid cells with eigenvectors of the successor representation as a design principle, we build this basis from eigenvectors of the transition matrix of a fixed reference policy. With such a basis, the successor features at a state-action pair are a linear combination of the base features at that same pair, which is not true in general, and the coefficients are known in closed form: each successor feature is its base feature multiplied by $θ_i = 1/(1-γλ_i)$, where $λ_i$ is its eigenvalue. The long-term return is thus predicted from the same features as the immediate reward, no successor-feature network or replay buffer is needed, and adapting to a new task reduces to a linear regression on the reward. The agent acts greedily on the action values of the reference policy, which is one step of policy improvement over it and suffices to reach a single goal. In a two-goal gridworld, with the uniform random walk as reference policy, whose eigenvectors are the low-frequency Laplacian eigenvectors, agents built this way maintain near-maximal return across every change of goal, whereas SimpleSF and DQN lose most of their return at each change.

summary.takeaway: 基于网格细胞与后继表示特征向量的联系，用固定参考策略转移矩阵的特征向量构造可复用基，使后继特征与即时奖励共享特征，并将持续强化学习中的任务适应简化为线性回归。
summary.methods: 以参考策略转移矩阵的特征向量为基，后继特征系数按θ_i=1/(1-γλ_i)闭式给出；无需后继特征网络或回放缓冲；在新任务上对奖励做线性回归，并按参考策略动作值贪婪行动；在双目标网格世界中以均匀随机游走为参考策略，与SimpleSF和DQN比较。
summary.relevance: 对应“强化学习”主题：该工作提出一种面向持续强化学习的表征与任务适应机制。
summary.caveat: 摘要中的实证仅涉及双目标网格世界这一特定设定；其闭式关系和贪婪策略的有效性在更复杂、非平稳或高维环境中的适用性尚未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Similarity-based OSF Logic for Flexible SPARQL Query Answering
papers.abstract: We present an updated version of fosf, a reasoner for fuzzy order-sorted feature (OSF) logic, with support for flexible SPARQL query answering over RDF knowledge graphs. Fuzzy OSF logic is a knowledge representation and reasoning language where feature symbols denote functions and sort symbols denote fuzzy sets. Sorts are organized in a fuzzy subsumption relation that extends to OSF terms, record-like structures representing classes of entities. The unification algorithm for these structures provides a calculus of fuzzy type subsumption. The latest release of fosf introduces support for similarity-based reasoning by extending the OSF language with a similarity relation among sorts, alongside a translation engine for compiling OSF terms into standard SPARQL. Queries expressed as OSF terms undergo fuzzy ontology-aware rewriting prior to translation. This process incorporates an OSF theory of sort definitions, feature domain and range declarations, and fuzzy subsumption and similarity relations through fuzzy OSF constraint normalization. This rewriting enables flexible query answering by returning approximate solutions, allowing queries that would otherwise be inconsistent with the underlying ontology to yield relevant results.

summary.takeaway: 更新了模糊有序排序特征逻辑推理器fosf，增加排序间相似关系支持，并引入将OSF项编译为标准SPARQL的翻译引擎，以支持灵活的SPARQL查询回答。
summary.methods: 扩展OSF语言，加入排序间相似关系；通过模糊OSF约束规范化，结合排序定义、特征域和值域声明、模糊包含和相似关系，对OSF项查询进行本体感知重写，再翻译为SPARQL；返回近似解。
summary.relevance: 对应“知识图谱”主题：该工作面向RDF知识图谱上的查询回答与本体感知查询重写。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供查询回答的精度、召回率或效率评估，也未说明相似关系如何获取及翻译后SPARQL查询的复杂度控制。

papers.title: From Cases to Criteria: Reusing Evaluation Knowledge for Task-Specific Rubric Generation
papers.abstract: Query-specific rubrics make LLM evaluation more fine-grained and transparent, and generating high-quality rubrics requires both identifying the target query's evaluation scope and specifying concrete checks. Historical rubrics provide reusable evaluation experiences, yet existing approaches reuse either complete query-rubric cases or aggregated criteria and dimensions without explicitly connecting recurring evaluation requirements to their criterion-level evidence and source-query context. This can preserve irrelevant task details or lose the broader evaluation structure. In this paper, we introduce RubricDuo, which organizes historical query-rubric pairs into a Rubric Knowledge Graph linking evaluation dimensions, shared concepts, local concepts, criteria, and queries, where reusable evaluation requirements across queries are abstracted by shared concepts. Given a target query, RubricDuo first combines concepts relevant to the target query with retrieved historical cases to draft a rubric with broad coverage. It then revisits each draft criterion, retrieves concept-linked historical criteria and their source queries, and adapts applicable evidence to refine the criterion. Experiments on RubricBench and HealthBench demonstrate that RubricDuo achieves the overall best performance among the evaluated automatic methods in both alignment with human-authored rubrics and downstream LLM judging.

summary.takeaway: 提出RubricDuo，将历史查询-评分标准对组织为评分标准知识图谱，通过共享概念抽象可复用评价要求，并为目标查询生成任务特定评分标准。
summary.methods: 构建连接评价维度、共享概念、局部概念、准则和查询的评分标准知识图谱；先结合目标查询相关概念与检索到的历史案例起草评分标准，再逐条检索概念关联的历史准则及其源查询以修正准则；在RubricBench和HealthBench上评估与人工评分标准的一致性及下游LLM评判效果。
summary.relevance: 对应“检索增强与对齐”和“知识图谱”主题：该工作利用知识图谱组织历史评价知识，并通过检索增强生成评分标准，服务于LLM评价与对齐。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体指标数值和基线细节；评估限于RubricBench和HealthBench，对其他任务领域和评分标准粒度的泛化性未说明。

papers.title: Prevalence of autoimmune hepatitis in patients with Sjögren disease: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Sjögren disease (SjD) and autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) may coexist, but the prevalence of AIH in SjD patients is unclear. This study investigated the prevalence and association. METHODS: Databases (Web of Science, Cochrane, Embase, PubMed, CNKI, Wanfang, CBMdisc, VIP) were searched up to November 14, 2025. Quality was assessed using NOS and JBI scales. Meta-analysis was performed with R 4.5.2 (PROSPERO: CRD420251233495). RESULTS: Fourteen studies (3697 SjD patients) were included. Overall prevalence of AIH in SjD was 2.55% (95% CI: 1.52%-4.26%). Prevalence varied by study type (retrospective cohort: 4.58%, cross-sectional: 1.72%, prospective cohort: 1.67%) and by country (China: 6.16%, Japan: 2.51%, Spain: 2.49%). Stratified by SjD diagnostic criteria (1993 European, 2002 AECG) and AIH scoring (1993 IAIHG), prevalence was approximately 2%. CONCLUSION: Prevalence of AIH in SjD patients varies significantly by study design and region. Early diagnosis and treatment of AIH may improve quality of life and prognosis in SjD patients. NOVEL INSIGHTS: This meta-analysis provides the first pooled estimate regarding the prevalence of autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) in patients with Sjögren disease (SjD): 2.55% (95% CI 1.52%-4.26%; 14 studies, 3697 patients). Subgroup analyses indicated that AIH prevalence was influenced by study design, whereas estimates stratified by SjD and AIH diagnostic criteria were of similar magnitude (approximately 2%). Regional estimates showed numerical differences, but the differences were not statistically significant; the numerically higher estimates may reflect differences in genetic susceptibility, selection bias, environmental factors, and medical screening strategies, as well as referral and detection bias. Given the observational and largely cross-sectional design of the included studies, these estimates only motivate a hypothesis-generating immunometabolic framework, rather than permitting causal or mechanistic inference. In this framework, the liver may serve as a source of autoantigens through modifications of oxidation, glycosylation, and lipidation, including the hepatocyte β2GPI-PON1 axis; this mechanism remains to be tested in the SjD-AIH overlap.

summary.takeaway: 该荟萃分析首次汇总估计干燥病（SjD）患者中自身免疫性肝炎（AIH）的患病率为2.55%，并提示该患病率随研究设计与地区不同而存在差异。
summary.methods: 系统检索Web of Science、Cochrane、Embase、PubMed、CNKI、万方、CBMdisc、维普至2025年11月14日；用NOS和JBI量表评估质量，用R 4.5.2进行荟萃分析（PROSPERO: CRD420251233495）；纳入14项研究、3697例SjD患者，并按研究类型、国家及诊断标准做亚组分析。
summary.relevance: 该文与给定主题“机制推理”相关，因为它提出一个假设生成性的免疫代谢框架，讨论肝脏通过氧化、糖基化、脂化修饰（包括肝细胞β2GPI-PON1轴）作为自身抗原来源，并明确指出该机制尚待验证。
summary.caveat: 纳入研究多为观察性、且以横断面设计为主，作者明确说明结果仅能启发假设，不能支持因果或机制推断；地区间差异无统计学显著性，可能受遗传易感性、选择偏倚、环境因素、筛查策略及转诊和检出偏倚影响。
